verdict.rationale: Mistral OCR produces LLM-ready output: markdown tables, structured JSON annotations, and labeled blocks in reading order, positioned as citation-ready RAG input. A community tester confirms strong PDF-to-markdown conversion. Header and footer content is routed into separate `header`/`footer` fields, but the docs never state that this furniture is removed from the main markdown body, and no broader denoising of repeated page elements is documented. One hands-on report also saw a whole page returned as an image instead of text. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that headers/footers and repeated page furniture are stripped from the main body text, independent verification of clean noise-free output across documents, and a documented markdown output spec for the full page.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I get clean markdown/JSON designed for LLM consumption, with noise like repeated headers and page furniture stripped
